Title: [Q-LSJ?] Wake with Evening's Freshness and Aura Reading

Messages.Author: teknoko.nl
Messages.Body:
Question:

If I play a wake w/ evening's freshness (i.e. do not replace until after
combat) and I play an Aura Reading, my hand size should be 8 instead of 9.
Now, when combat ends, I would have to discard. Do I draw the card from the
wake first, and then discard because of the Aura Reading, or the other way
around, or do I get a choice in the matter ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"teknoko.nl" wrote:
>
> Question:
>
> If I play a wake w/ evening's freshness (i.e. do not replace until after
> combat) and I play an Aura Reading, my hand size should be 8 instead of 9.

Wake is "Do not replace until your untap phase", BTW.
Assuming instead that you play a Dodge...

> Now, when combat ends, I would have to discard. Do I draw the card from the
> wake first, and then discard because of the Aura Reading, or the other way
> around, or do I get a choice in the matter ?

You choose - either discard two and then replace the Dodge, or replace the Dodge
and then discard two.
